[[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]] | team = Bàsquet Manresa | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1998|5|15|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Bescanó]], Spain | high_school = | college = * [[Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball|Texas A&M]] (2016–2017) * [[Northwest Florida State College|Northwest Florida State]] (2018–2019) * [[UTEP Miners men's basketball|UTEP]] (2019–2020) | draft_year = 2021 | career_start = 2014 | years1 = 2014–2016 | team1 = [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] | years2 = 2014–2016 | team2 = →[[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|FC Barcelona B]] | years3 = 2021–2024 | team3 = [[Bàsquet Girona|Girona]] | years4 = 2024–2025 | team4 = [[CB Breogan|Río Breogán]] | years5 = 2025–2026 | team5 = [[CB Gran Canaria|Gran Canaria]] | years6 = 2026–present | team6 = [[Bàsquet Manresa|Manresa]] | highlights = | medaltemplates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{bk|ESP}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA U16 European Championship]]}} {{MedalBronze|[[2014 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship|2014 France]]|[[Spain men's national under-16 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Eric Martínez Vila''' (born 15 May 1998) is a Spanish [[basketball]] player for [[Bàsquet Manresa]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]]. He has also represented the [[Spain men's national basketball team|Spanish national team]] internationally. Standing at 2.11 m (6 ft 11 in), Vila plays as a [[power forward]]. ==Early life and youth career== A native of [[Bescanó]] ([[Province of Girona|Girona]]), he played for [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] at the youth level since he was 12 years old. Vila received regular playing time for the [[reserve team]], [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|FC Barcelona B]]. In December 2014, at age 16, he became the youngest player in club history to play in the [[Liga ACB]].{{cite web |title=Eric Vila and Stefan Peno youngest league debutants in FC Barcelona history |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/1115993/eric-vila-and-stefan-peno-youngest-league-debutants-in-fc-barcelona-history# |publisher=[[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] |accessdate=15 April 2020 |date=14 December 2014}} ==College career== Vila started playing college basketball in the United States with [[Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball|Texas A&M]]. After one season, he transferred to [[Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball|Fresno State]], sitting out his following year, but did not play for the team.{{cite web |last1=Phillips |first1=Scott |title=Fresno State lands Texas A&M transfer Eric Vila |url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2017/08/03/fresno-state-lands-texas-am-transfer-eric-vila/ |publisher=[[NBC Sports]] |accessdate=15 April 2020 |date=3 August 2017}} Vila played for [[Northwest Florida State College]] in 2018–19 before moving to [[UTEP Miners men's basketball|UTEP]] as a [[redshirt (college sports)|redshirt]] junior.{{cite web |last1=Stringer |first1=Seth |title=Vila’s versatility shining for Raiders |url=https://www.nwfdailynews.com/sports/20181207/vilas-versatility-shining-for-raiders |website=[[Northwest Florida Daily News]] |accessdate=15 April 2020 |date=7 December 2018}}{{cite web |last1=Chavez |first1=Felix F. |title=UTEP basketball signee Eric Vila having big season on junior college level |url=https://www.elpasotimes.com/story/sports/college/utep/2019/03/15/utep-basketball-signee-eric-vila-stars-northwest-florida-state/3153218002/ |website=[[El Paso Times]] |accessdate=15 April 2020 |date=15 March 2019}} He averaged 3.0 points and 5.0 rebounds per game.{{cite news |title=UTEP Basketball Season Ticket renewals and requests begin |url=https://elpasoheraldpost.com/utep-basketball-season-ticket-renewals-and-requests-begin/ |access-date=3 August 2021 |work=[[El Paso Herald Post]] |date=4 June 2020}} ==Professional career== On 17 July 2021, Vila signed with [[Bàsquet Girona]] of the [[LEB Oro]].{{cite web |title=Èric Vila is the sixth new player of Bàsquet Girona |url=https://basquetgirona.com/senior/en/news/eric-vila-is-the-sixth-new-player-of-basquet-girona.html |website=Basquet Girona |access-date=3 August 2021 |date=17 July 2021}} Vila continued to play with Girona as the team achieved promotion to the [[Liga ACB]] and played in the first tier of [[Spanish basketball league system|Spanish basketball]] from the [[2022-23 ACB season|2022-23 season]]. He extended his contract with Girona for a further season in July 2023.{{cite web |title=Èric Vila segueix sent gironí |url=https://basquetgirona.com/noticia/eric-vila-segueix-sent-gironi/ |website=basquetgirona.com |access-date=6 June 2025 |date=11 July 2023 |lang=ca}} He would leave Girona in June 2024, after three seasons with the Catalans.{{cite web |first=Guillem |last=Camps |title=Èric Vila tanca la seva etapa al Bàsquet Girona i el seu nou destí és el Breogán |url=https://www.diaridegirona.cat/esports/2024/06/30/eric-vila-tanca-seva-etapa-104640064.html |website=diaridegirona.cat |access-date=6 June 2025 |date=30 June 2024 |lang=ca}} In June 2024, Vila signed with [[CB Breogán|Río Breogán]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{cite web |title=Eric Vila, nuevo jugador del Río Breogán |url=https://www.cbbreogan.com/es/eric-vila-nuevo-jugador-del-rio-breogan |website=cbbreogan.com |access-date=6 June 2025 |lang=es}} Vila became an important player in Breogán's roster, playing in all 34 [[2024-25 ACB season|regular season]] games and recording his best numbers (21 points) in a win against [[Unicaja Málaga]].{{cite web |first=Nacho |last=Fouz |title=Eric Vila: "Soy feliz en Lugo; soy una persona sencilla que viene de un pueblo" |url=https://www.elprogreso.es/articulo/deporte-local-lugo/eric-vila-soy-feliz-lugo-soy-persona-sencilla-que-viene-pueblo/202502131122481846716.html |date=13 February 2025 |website=elprogreso.es |access-date=6 June 2025 |lang=es}} On July 17, 2025, Vila signed a two season contract with [[CB Gran Canaria]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{cite web |title=El Dreamland Gran Canaria se hace con los servicios de Eric Vila |url=https://www.acb.com/articulo/ver/519370-el-dreamland-gran-canaria-se-hace-con-los-servicios-de-eric-vila.html |date=17 July 2025 |website=acb.com |access-date=17 July 2025 |lang=es}} In June 2026, Gran Canaria announced Vila had activated his contract's release clause and would therefore leave the club.{{cite web |title=Eric Vila ejecuta la cláusula de salida de su contrato y queda libre |url=https://cbgrancanaria.net/news/eric-vila-ejecuta-la-clausula-de-salida-de-su-contrato-y-queda-libre/ |date=24 June 2026 |website=acb.com |access-date=24 June 2026 |lang=es}} On June 25, 2026, Vila signed a two-season contract with [[Bàsquet Manresa]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{cite web |title=Eric Vila: alçada, tir de 3 i experiència al servei del Kids&Us Manresa |url=https://www.basquetmanresa.com/noticies/equips/noticies/2026/eric-vila-alcada-tir-de-3-i-experiencia-al-servei-del-kidsus-manresa/ |date=25 June 2026 |website=basquetmanresa.com |access-date=25 June 2026 |lang=ca}} ==National team career== Vila has represented Spain in several international tournaments. In 2014, he helped his team win a bronze medal at the [[2014 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship|FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]] in Latvia. In the [[2017 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|2017 FIBA Under-19 World Cup]] in [[Cairo]], Vila averaged 13 points, 10.9 rebounds and 2.7 assists per game. At the quarterfinals of the tournament, he recorded 24 points, 11 rebounds and three assists in a 70–58 win over [[Argentina men's national under-19 basketball team|Argentina]].{{cite web |title=Eric Vila with 24 points and 11 rebounds against Argentina |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/world/u19/2017/news/eric-vila-s-double-double-sends-spain-into-semi-finals |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=15 April 2020 |date=7 July 2017}} In February 2025, Vila was called up by the senior [[Spain men's national basketball team|Spanish national team]] to play in [[EuroBasket 2025 qualification]] games.{{cite web |title=Scariolo convoca a Eric Vila para jugar con España ante Letonia y Bélgica |url=https://www.lavozdegalicia.es/noticia/forzabreo/2025/02/11/scariolo-convoca-eric-vila-jugar-espana-ante-letonia-belgica/00031739266658357974237.htm |website=lavozdegalicia.es |access-date=6 June 2025 |date=11 February 2025 |lang=es}} Vila has also represented the [[Catalonia national basketball team|Catalan national team]] in [[exhibition games]].{{cite web |title=La lista de la selección catalana para el amistoso frente a Argentina del mes de julio |url=https://www.gigantes.com/selecciones/la-lista-de-la-seleccion-catalana-para-el-amistoso-frente-a-argentina-del-mes-de-julio/
